dependencies.title: Extreme gaps between eigenvalues of random matrices
dependencies.pinned_version: Annals of Probability 41 (2013), 2648–2681; author-hosted published PDF
dependencies.mapping: For Haar CUE(N), consecutive circular eigenangle gaps scaled by N^(4/3), with angular location in an interior arc, converge to a marked Poisson process. Integrating over angle gives gap intensity u^2 du/(24 pi). Seam and all-pair singular-tail reductions are proved separately in the project; no theorem about the fixed deterministic map is supplied by this source.

dependencies.title: Loop Equations Characterize Random Matrix Statistics
dependencies.mapping: Used only for the loop-hierarchy characterization/convergence implication. The approximate mixed loop equations for the maintained deterministic model remain a project hypothesis.

dependencies.title: Universally optimal distribution of points on spheres
dependencies.mapping: For N>=2 the regular N-gon on S^1 is a sharp configuration (N=1 is immediate). Theorem 1.2 minimizes pair energy for completely monotone functions of squared chord distance; the project potential f_q(r)=(1-q^2)/((1-q)^2+qr) meets this hypothesis. Continuity extends the inequality to spectral multisets with repeated phases.

dependencies.title: Solutions of polynomial equation over F_p and new bounds of additive energy
dependencies.mapping: Applied to the displayed absolutely irreducible subgroup curve after the project's degree and size-range checks.

dependencies.title: Some cases of Vojta's conjecture on integral points over function fields
dependencies.mapping: Applied to the smooth Cayley curve after explicit degree, boundary, separability, and translated-subtorus checks.

dependencies.title: Algebraic trace functions over the primes
dependencies.mapping: The project reproduces the proof on the common good open to handle moving bad points; no stronger black-box statement is assumed.

dependencies.title: Torsion points on elliptic curves over function fields and a theorem of Igusa
dependencies.mapping: Supplies arithmetic openness/irreducibility input in the corrected elliptic off/off route after project-specific non-isotriviality and singular-support checks.

dependencies.title: Analytic Number Theory
dependencies.mapping: Used only for the stated dyadic averaged split-design prime-counting arguments; no pointwise PNT for a varying modulus is assumed.

dependencies.title: Chapter 4: Transcendence results
dependencies.locator: Theorem 4.8 and Corollary 4.9(i), printed page 48, PDF page 4
dependencies.mapping: For two distinct algebraic exponents 0 and i tau N(lambda-mu), coefficients -1 and 1, exponentials cannot coincide. This gives qualitative injectivity only, no spectral gap. The underlying single-chain representation was already recorded in supplement/fixed_map/weighted-secular/attempt.md.

dependencies.title: Characteristic Lyapunov exponents and smooth ergodic theory
dependencies.mapping: Smooth normalized area invariant under analytic G_kappa has entropy equal to its positive Lyapunov exponent, the integral of log unstable expansion; together with the Ruelle inequality this identifies P(-phi)=0.

dependencies.title: An inequality for the entropy of differentiable maps
dependencies.identifier: Boletim da Sociedade Brasileira de Matematica 9 (1978), 83-87; https://www.ihes.fr/~ruelle/PUBLICATIONS/%5B51%5D.pdf
dependencies.mapping: For every invariant probability on the smooth area-preserving Anosov two-torus, entropy is at most the integral of the one-dimensional unstable potential; hence P(-phi)<=0.

dependencies.title: Zeta functions and the periodic orbit structure of hyperbolic dynamics
dependencies.locator: Appendix III Markov partitions, Theorem 2.2 (PDF p. 25), Proposition 3.2 and Theorem 3.5 (pp. 41, 46), Propositions 4.7, 4.11, 4.12 (pp. 61, 65-66)
dependencies.mapping: Markov coding and Gibbs cylinder estimates yield the weighted two-endpoint pressure exponent; uniqueness and mixing identify equilibrium measures, strict convexity from nonconstant periodic unstable multipliers gives P(phi)>2h_top, analyticity and Hessian identify the perturbative variance. Endpoint comparison and kick coefficient are derived in the project rather than quoted as standalone external theorems.

dependencies.title: A simple and self-contained proof for the Lindemann-Weierstrass theorem
dependencies.locator: Theorem 3.2 (the linear independence of exponentials of distinct algebraic exponents over all algebraic coefficients); Corollary 3.2, printed p.16 (nonzero complex algebraic exponent has transcendental exponential)
dependencies.mapping: For nonzero real algebraic time t, collected finite exponential polynomials with real algebraic frequencies vanish at t exactly when identically zero; used with a separate imaginary-time nonvanishing witness for discriminants, resultants and fixed-model traces. The theorem gives no quantitative lower bound. The algebraic-entry antiunitary corollary uses the same input. TRACE-013 uses only Corollary 3.2 and nonzero algebraic-coefficient polynomials at one transcendental exponential for its factorial flat perturbation. FLOW-013 uses Corollary 3.2 for one eigenvalue rotation, ensuring all positive power traces of its abstract clustered starting family are nonzero without quantitative cancellation.

dependencies.title: Une version effective du théorème de Lindemann-Weierstrass par des méthodes d'indépendance algébrique
dependencies.mapping: Applied to a Q-independent integral-trace basis of exponent frequencies and the explicit integer norm of a frozen spectral discriminant. It gives an astronomically small gap bound only at odd 7-not-dividing-N and no trace cancellation.

dependencies.title: Some exact correlations in the Dyson Brownian motion model for transitions to the CUE
dependencies.mapping: Prior circular Dyson clock kernel. Project rederives odd-N normalization and an explicit uniform bound, then applies its quadratic-noise comparison. No novelty for Dyson clock relaxation.

dependencies.title: Semi-classical formula beyond the Ehrenfest time in quantum chaos. (I) Trace formula
dependencies.mapping: Conditional plane fixed-time input. Even-N torus theorem is not directly applicable to odd project dimensions. Exact parity repair is recorded; full source-to-model identification remains conditional. As of 4 October, bounded fixed-time traces are proved independently by the odd-N packet/frame argument; the sharper action-phase adaptation here remains conditional.

dependencies.title: Fractal uncertainty for discrete two-dimensional Cantor sets
dependencies.locator: Theorem 2, printed p. 3; sharpness in Section 5.2 inspected, even-base failure derived internally
dependencies.mapping: Both alphabets equal A_M={(r,s):r!=s}; both iterates have side N=M^k and unitary 2D Fourier normalization 1/N. Project geometry excludes orthogonal full affine torus lines for odd M, and derives exact norm 1 at every scale internally for even M>=4 by an explicit supported unit vector. Binary norm is derived internally. Ideal digit model only; no actual doubled-map FUP or nonlinear coordinate-distortion hypothesis is supplied.

dependencies.title: Images of eigenvalue distributions under power maps
dependencies.identifier: arXiv:math/0008079; Probability Theory and Related Fields 125 (2003), 522–538
dependencies.mapping: For Haar V in U(n), eigenvalues of V^d are the union of d independent Haar spectra of sizes ceil((n-i)/d), 0<=i<d. Project n=p and power d=d_p. Used only for the correct reference block law; not needed for the elementary sector criterion and gives no deterministic block independence or cancellation.

dependencies.title: Linear functionals of eigenvalues of random matrices
dependencies.pinned_version: Author-hosted Berkeley tech-report 577, 19-page PDF; retrieved 30 September 2026
dependencies.mapping: Exact Haar-CUE joint trace moments equal Gaussian moments when both weighted degrees are <=N. All sixth, cubic/pair cross and pair/pair moments in the low-band arbitrary-weight variance have degree <=4 max I<=N. No arbitrary-Heisenberg Gaussian independence or deterministic-map theorem follows. TRACE-011 uses background dimension H=N-K and verifies 4bN<=H for the mixed-cluster second/fourth/sixth moments. Its all-band pair covariance and occupancy controls are separately derived by finite determinants, without Gaussian matching beyond the stable range.

dependencies.title: Uniform expansion bounds for Cayley graphs of SL2(Fp)
dependencies.mapping: Fixed S,V in SL2(Z) generate a non-elementary subgroup, as witnessed by hyperbolic S,R with disjoint quadratic eigenline fields. Uniform Cayley gap transfers to nontrivial finite-group unitary irreducible representations. Laziness gives the auxiliary HS channel gap; no prescribed-word universality follows.

dependencies.title: Evenly distributed unitaries: on the structure of unitary designs
dependencies.locator: Theorem 2; Section III.B, equation (20), Theorem 6; Section IV.C
dependencies.mapping: Prior frame-potential/character identity and Clifford two-design mechanism. Exact even-sector ranks and a full-space orbit-compression gap proof are reconstructed in the project. No quantum-design average is treated as a deterministic word spectral theorem.

dependencies.title: There are infinitely many prime numbers in all arithmetic progressions with first term and difference coprime
dependencies.identifier: Original 1837 paper; English translation arXiv:0808.1408v2; https://arxiv.org/pdf/0808.1408
dependencies.locator: The theorem stated in the opening paragraph, p.1, proved in the original article
dependencies.mapping: Use only infinitely many primes p=1 mod20, since gcd(1,20)=1. Fourth-power order divisibility is proved separately. No maximal-order assertion.

dependencies.title: Cyclic Polya Ensembles on the Unitary Matrices and their Spectral Statistics
dependencies.locator: Proposition 12, (2.4.10), printed p.18; Theorem 7(3), p.13; Proposition 21, (3.2.2)-(3.2.3), pp.33-34
dependencies.mapping: Prior finite arbitrary-start circular Brownian biorthogonal kernel used in FLOW-014 and finite identity calibration. Source heat time is project time/(2N), verified by the fundamental-character decay. Prop.21 distinct-spectrum condition retained; project uses gap-independent bounds and finite-N Laplace continuity for confluence. Heat Laurent series analytic on every annulus. No microscopic asymptotic theorem or BGS implication imported; the global contour/Fredholm analysis is a separate project proof.

dependencies.title: Almost flat highest weights and application to Wilson loops on compact surfaces
dependencies.pinned_version: Canonical primary PDF internally marked v3, 26 May 2025; title-page date 27 May; version-suffixed URL unavailable, no local PDF bytes/hash
dependencies.locator: Section 1.2, printed p.3; Section 2, equations (17)--(18), printed p.10
dependencies.mapping: Prior normalized unitary Casimir and character heat multiplier. Project generator is half the normalized Laplacian; highest weight (r,0,...,-r) decays at r(r+N-1)/N. Full Brownian fundamental and determinant rate 1/2; traceless determinant rate zero, fundamental (1-N^-2)/2. Charge-zero characters unchanged. Re-derived analytically in D18--D19; no Yang--Mills asymptotic or deterministic BGS import.

dependencies.title: The one-dimensional log-gas free energy has a unique minimiser
dependencies.pinned_version: Canonical primary PDF internally marked v1, 17 December 2018; title-page date 18 December; version-suffixed URL unavailable, no local PDF bytes/hash
dependencies.locator: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1.1, printed p.2; Definition 2.9, equation (2.17), and Definition 2.10, equation (2.18), printed p.7
dependencies.mapping: Source definition of specific relative entropy to unit-intensity Poisson and prior uniqueness of Sine_beta as the free-energy minimizer at intensity one. The project separately proves infinite entropy of every raw finite deterministic periodic spectral field. The source does not supply minimizing property for the actual map, finite-entropy near-minimality of those raw fields or an entropy upper bound for a weak limit.

dependencies.title: Determinantal random point fields
dependencies.locator: Section 3, Theorem 7, printed pp.38-42; statement p.40
dependencies.mapping: The intensity-one sine Fourier projection on [-1/2,1/2] is Hermitian, a positive contraction and locally trace class. Theorem 7 supplies spatial translation ergodicity of its determinantal probability law. Mean ergodic averaging for L2 local factorial observables is used after the internally proved chain moments. The periodic conditional-law Jensen step and order of limits are project proofs; no temporal Dyson ergodicity or deterministic BGS identification is imported.

dependencies.title: Non-Equilibrium Dynamics of Dyson's Model with an Infinite Number of Particles
dependencies.mapping: Prior integer-lattice Dyson relaxation kernel and sine attraction, credited as known. Source Brownian spatial time is project Nt/(4 pi^2); transpose the equal-time kernel and shift the uniform lattice phase. FLOW-018 independently derives the finite circular limit, without importing line truncation topology or a new infinite SDE construction.

dependencies.title: Mehler's formulas for the univariate complex Hermite polynomials and applications
dependencies.pinned_version: arXiv v1, 21 July 2017, five-page primary PDF; inspected 5 October 2026
dependencies.locator: Generating function (2.4), printed p.2; Theorem 4.1 and (4.5), printed p.4
dependencies.mapping: Prior complex Hermite/Mehler identity, credited without world-priority claim. H^[m]_(a,b)=m^(a+b)H^(1/m)_(a,b); substitute source nu=1/m and u=v=rm, 0<r<1, giving factor (1-r^2)^-1 and exponent 2r|z|^2/[m(1+r)]. FLOW-020 also reconstructs this positive-real specialization via a Gaussian kernel and Parseval. No larger complex parameter range, growing Haar CLT or deterministic universality imported. Journal metadata only corroborated; no uninspected PDF byte hash.
